frame: This is a Vite, React and TypeScript app with shadcn/ui, and the tradecn registry's items are installed under src/components, src/hooks and src/lib. Build with them. The screen goes in src/App.tsx, which src/main.tsx already renders. Add files under src/ as you need them, and mock every piece of data inside the app. When you're done, `bunx vite build` has to succeed. Don't start a dev server or anything else that keeps running.

expectations.claim: With the kit installed, a coding agent builds screens that keep the item contract more often than without it.
expectations.note: Written before the first run and never edited to fit one. A definition that turns out to measure the wrong thing is replaced by a new file with its own date, and this one stays beside it, unedited.

gpt-5.6-sol.why: contract 100% with the kit against 0% without

gpt-5.6-terra.why: contract 80% with the kit against 0% without; lower with the kit: renders
